info.title: Assurance scoped qualification service operations
info.description: Current signed qualification and publication boundaries. Every command key is bound to the verified service/principal, operation and request; current authority is recomputed on retries and no qualification response is cached.

200.description: Current bounded owner result, never a native-write grant

403.description: Denied, invalid, conflicting or unavailable; no qualification authority is inferred.

422.description: Denied, invalid, conflicting or unavailable; no qualification authority is inferred.

503.description: Denied, invalid, conflicting or unavailable; no qualification authority is inferred.

401.description: Denied, invalid, conflicting or unavailable; no qualification authority is inferred.

409.description: Denied, invalid, conflicting or unavailable; no qualification authority is inferred.

x-idempotency.description: Owner records request digests under authenticated tenant, principal and operation. Reads recompute current authority, never replay cached support; publications also retain their existing immutable command_id receipt.
